feedback_bong_wav_215774.use: A calm bell for a neutral notice or a reflective beat.
feedback_bong_wav_215774.avoid: Fast or energetic sequences; it rings for over a second.

feedback_computer_beep_2_220182.description: Quick and staticky computer beep with acknowledgement feel -
feedback_computer_beep_2_220182.use: A machine acknowledging input — terminal output, a system responding.
feedback_computer_beep_2_220182.avoid: Human or emotional moments; it is deliberately mechanical.

feedback_denymachine_wav_411695.description: Mixed in Audacity using recordings from Zoom H6 Record
feedback_denymachine_wav_411695.use: A harsher, longer denial for a serious failure or a hard stop.
feedback_denymachine_wav_411695.avoid: Minor mistakes; it is heavy enough to feel punitive.

feedback_ding_station_annoucement_notifi.description: Train Station Announcement Notification "Ding" Sound. Recorded in Queensland, Australia 2021.
feedback_ding_station_annoucement_notifi.use: An attention cue before an important statement, like a public announcement chime.
feedback_ding_station_annoucement_notifi.avoid: Success confirmation — it announces rather than rewards.

feedback_gasp_chimes_success_2_wav_54198.description: Sound FX implying a successful interaction or moment - Variation 2.
feedback_gasp_chimes_success_2_wav_54198.use: A gentler success than the triple ping, for a small confirmation.
feedback_gasp_chimes_success_2_wav_54198.avoid: Major payoffs — it is too soft to carry them.

feedback_gasp_chimes_success_3_wav_54198.description: Sound FX implying a successful interaction or moment - Variation 3.
feedback_gasp_chimes_success_3_wav_54198.use: A second success variation, so two confirmations in a row do not sound identical.
feedback_gasp_chimes_success_3_wav_54198.avoid: Isolated use where variation 2 already fits.

feedback_multimedia_sfx_error_01_wav_699.description: An aggressive buzz multimedia sound effect that could be used as an error noise.
feedback_multimedia_sfx_error_01_wav_699.use: A short negative buzz: a rejected value, a wrong answer, a failing step.
feedback_multimedia_sfx_error_01_wav_699.avoid: Anything neutral — the sound is unambiguously an error.

feedback_triple_ping_notification_sound_.description: A surgically engineered, high-visibility 3-note notification chime (E6 - G6 - C7). Designed specifically for mobile phone speakers and high-noise environments using advanced acoustic principles. Design Process: - Timbre: Built using FabFilter Twin 3 (Square/Saw harmonics) layered with a calibrated W
feedback_triple_ping_notification_sound_.use: A positive result: a completed count, a correct answer, a finished process.
feedback_triple_ping_notification_sound_.avoid: Neutral or negative moments; the rising three-note figure is explicitly happy.

impact_box_shatter_wav_678535.description: Composite sfx of a cardboard box being dropped from different heights and angels.
impact_box_shatter_wav_678535.use: Something breaking apart, collapsing, or being destroyed on screen.
impact_box_shatter_wav_678535.avoid: Clean, ordinary landings — the debris tail implies destruction.

impact_hit_5_676465.description: The sound of a hit by punching a sandbag Mic: Neumann TLM 103 Recorded on an API Legacy Plus Console Mono WAV File
impact_hit_5_676465.use: An element landing hard after a spring — place it on the first overshoot.
impact_hit_5_676465.avoid: Metallic or digital surfaces; this is a soft, bodied thud.

impact_percussion_hit_207863.use: A rhythmic accent on a beat: a number appearing, a list item snapping in.
impact_percussion_hit_207863.avoid: Physical collisions — it reads as music, not as an object hitting something.

impact_slightmetallicthud_mp3_686282.description: A somewhat silly sounding metallic thud.
impact_slightmetallicthud_mp3_686282.use: A card, panel, or badge dropping into place with a light metallic edge.
impact_slightmetallicthud_mp3_686282.avoid: Heavy, cinematic moments — it is too small and slightly comic.

impact_sound_design_elements_impact_sfx_.description: Support me buy me coffee : https://buymeacoffee.com/audiopapkin Impact effect,is perfect for cinematic uses,video games. Effects recorded from the field. Recording gear-Tascam Portacapture x8 and Microphone - RØDE NTG5 Native Instrume
impact_sound_design_elements_impact_sfx_.use: A designed cinematic hit on a major reveal or the final frame of a title.
impact_sound_design_elements_impact_sfx_.avoid: Repeated use; at nearly two seconds it takes over the mix.

impact_synth_kick_3_266764.use: A low-end punch under a reveal or a hard cut, for electronic and tech material.
impact_synth_kick_3_266764.avoid: Organic or physical events; it is unmistakably a synth drum.

movement_glass_slide_9_323421.description: Me sliding a glass cup around on a wooden surface. Check out my pack if this particular slide doesn't suit you! Recorded on Zoom Q4 Mic
movement_glass_slide_9_323421.use: An element dragging along a surface, or a panel sliding out with friction.
movement_glass_slide_9_323421.avoid: Free-floating motion in empty space — the scrape implies contact.

movement_piece_slide_mp3_546118.description: This is an SFX that we created for our Chess game. It indicates a chess piece sliding on a board.
movement_piece_slide_mp3_546118.use: A small element stepping or snapping to a new position on a grid or board.
movement_piece_slide_mp3_546118.avoid: Long travels; the sound is over in a third of a second.

movement_sci_fi_riser_synth_whoosh_76019.description: Not really sure how to describe this sound, made using a CC0 paper tear sfx — from a pack made by Jan Schupke —, processing that with phasereplicant and adding random effects.
movement_sci_fi_riser_synth_whoosh_76019.use: A long build into a reveal — a whoosh and a riser in one, for tech and sci-fi material.
movement_sci_fi_riser_synth_whoosh_76019.avoid: Short beats; at over three seconds it dominates a fast cut.

movement_short_woosh_04_wav_582895.description: A whoosh, swipe, or wipe. It could also be an interface entry sound.
movement_short_woosh_04_wav_582895.use: An interface panel or card wiping across the frame.
movement_short_woosh_04_wav_582895.avoid: Physical or organic motion; this one is abstract and synthetic.

movement_swinging_staff_whoosh_low_03_wa.description: Swinging a bamboo stick through the air. Part of a pack of 20 high and low force sounds.
movement_swinging_staff_whoosh_low_03_wa.use: A heavy or large object swinging through frame; low-frequency weight.
movement_swinging_staff_whoosh_low_03_wa.avoid: Light, delicate elements such as text or thin icons.

movement_swishes_12_slower_strong_wav_61.description: I did some swishes myself using a spiral hose; I needed them for specific situations in video editing and the bamboo swishes I found here on freesound were too fast and strong. The flexible spiral hose made for some nice and slower swishes; Some of the 16 sounds build up a little, some are very fast
movement_swishes_12_slower_strong_wav_61.use: A slower, wider pan or a camera move that takes about a second.
movement_swishes_12_slower_strong_wav_61.avoid: Snappy pops and quick entries; its slow build lands late on them.

movement_swishes_9_hill_curve_stronger_w.description: I did some swishes myself using a spiral hose; I needed them for specific situations in video editing and the bamboo swishes I found here on freesound were too fast and strong. The flexible spiral hose made for some nice and slower swishes; Some of the 16 sounds build up a little, some are very fast
movement_swishes_9_hill_curve_stronger_w.use: A large element sweeping across the frame on a curved path, or a hard scene cut.
movement_swishes_9_hill_curve_stronger_w.avoid: Small UI motion — it is too big and too long for a single icon.

movement_swoosh_v2_786514.description: This swoosh sound is a short, descending-frequency effect designed to create a smooth and dynamic auditory cue. Built using a sine wave, ensuring a smooth, clean, and natural tonal quality without harsh or mechanical artifacts. Purpose and Feel: - The descending pitch creates a sense of completion,
movement_swoosh_v2_786514.use: A synthetic scene-to-scene transition, or an element settling as it leaves; the descending pitch reads as closure.
movement_swoosh_v2_786514.avoid: Something entering or rising — the falling pitch fights upward motion.

movement_wooden_stick_swing_1_2_485277.description: Recorded and processed at 24bit 48kHz using the Tascam DR-40 Linear PCM Recorder. Processing: Gain-staging and soft high and low frequency filtering. No EQ boost or cuts anywhere else. Also De-noised.
movement_wooden_stick_swing_1_2_485277.use: A mid-weight swing when the low whoosh is too heavy and the short one too thin.
movement_wooden_stick_swing_1_2_485277.avoid: UI-scale motion and abstract digital transitions.

movement_woosh_1_614084.description: Sound of a weapon being swung.
movement_woosh_1_614084.use: A fast element flying or sliding into frame; the sharpest, shortest whoosh in the library.
movement_woosh_1_614084.avoid: Slow drifts, gentle fades, and anything that should feel calm.

transition_basic_riser_one_806664.description: A basic riser for your music and cinematic needs. Engineered and produced by JOHN E. REYNOLDS for JOHNJOHNFM LLC.
transition_basic_riser_one_806664.use: A four-second build into a major reveal; start it well before the payoff frame.
transition_basic_riser_one_806664.avoid: Anything shorter than four seconds — it will be cut off mid-build.

transition_fx_boom_816082.description: Ableton Live. VST.Serum......Fx boom Free Music Slap House Dance EDM Loop Electro Clap Drums Kick Drum Snare Bass Dance Club Psytrance Drumroll Trance Sample .
transition_fx_boom_816082.use: The landing under a reveal: place it exactly on the frame the payoff appears.
transition_fx_boom_816082.avoid: Small UI beats; the sub-bass is out of scale for them.

transition_impact_roll_535607.description: Impact roll.....451 Downloads 0 Likes come on guys you can do better 😑👍
transition_impact_roll_535607.use: A boom with a rolling tail that carries into the next scene; good for act breaks.
transition_impact_roll_535607.avoid: Tight cuts — the three-second tail bleeds over the following beat.

transition_riser_hit_sfx_097_754771.description: Support me buy me coffee : https://buymeacoffee.com/audiopapkin Riser Hit effect,is perfect for cinematic uses,video games. Effects recorded from the field. Recording gear-Tascam Portacapture x8 and Microphone - RØDE NTG5 Native Instr
transition_riser_hit_sfx_097_754771.use: A riser and its landing hit in one file, when the reveal needs no separate boom.
transition_riser_hit_sfx_097_754771.avoid: Pairing with another impact — the hit is already inside it.

ui_classic_click_671105.description: Clicking on something never felt so satisfying.
ui_classic_click_671105.use: The tightest click in the library — rapid successive items where anything longer would smear.
ui_classic_click_671105.avoid: Moments that need weight; at 0.09s it is nearly subliminal.

ui_click_basic_220197.use: A softer, rounder click for a slower interface beat.
ui_click_basic_220197.avoid: Fast repeats — its half-second tail overlaps the next one.

ui_clock_bonmark_tick_wav_509714.use: A counter incrementing or time passing; the natural tick for a number animation.
ui_clock_bonmark_tick_wav_509714.avoid: Selection and confirmation — it reads as time, not as input.

ui_computer_keyboard_single_key_typ_3801.description: Computer keyboard typing sound individual keystroke sound #6 - spacebar sound
ui_computer_keyboard_single_key_typ_3801.use: Typewriter effects — the wider spacebar-like key, for word boundaries.
ui_computer_keyboard_single_key_typ_3801.avoid: Non-textual animation; it is unmistakably a keyboard.

ui_computer_keyboard_single_key_typ_3801.description: Computer keyboard typing sound individual keystroke sound #5 - shift key sound
ui_computer_keyboard_single_key_typ_3801.use: The per-character keystroke in a typewriter effect; place one every 2-3 characters.

ui_metal_tick_3_185609.description: One shot sample of cutting. Made with ventilation cap.
ui_metal_tick_3_185609.use: A sharp step in a sequence: a progress marker or a diagram node lighting up.
ui_metal_tick_3_185609.avoid: Soft or organic material; the metallic edge is prominent.

ui_mouth_pop4_wav_323738.description: using my mouth to make a pop sound
ui_mouth_pop4_wav_323738.use: A playful pop for light, informal material.
ui_mouth_pop4_wav_323738.avoid: Corporate or technical videos — its mouth origin is audible.

ui_pop_sfx_neutral_776016.description: manually recorded and cleaned up in ableton (EQ used)
ui_pop_sfx_neutral_776016.use: A card, badge, or tooltip popping into existence at scale 0 → 1.
ui_pop_sfx_neutral_776016.avoid: Motion that travels; a pop implies appearing in place.

ui_ppop_wav_527522.description: "Pop" sound, like a popping bubble or a cork popping out of a bottle, made with my finger and mouth.
ui_ppop_wav_527522.use: A tiny bright pop for small icons or bullet points appearing in sequence.
ui_ppop_wav_527522.avoid: Large elements; the sound is far smaller than they look.

ui_tang1_wav_138096.description: sound of a stripping plier squize(for electric wire)recorded with my phone
ui_tang1_wav_138096.use: A mechanical snap for something locking into place.
ui_tang1_wav_138096.avoid: Digital interface beats; the sound is clearly a physical tool.

ui_ui_click_839832.description: Created for the video game DystOcean, I made all sounds with my mouth + mixing. Credit would be cool, but not necessary^^ Would also be interested in where they end up DystOcean Link: https://tom-grzembke.itch.io/dystocean
ui_ui_click_839832.use: The default click: a list item, a button, or a selection appearing.
ui_ui_click_839832.avoid: Physical mechanisms; this is a clean interface click.

ui_uihover1_wav_488381.description: Sound played when hovering over an UI element in a videogame. Made for a cancelled student game. Created from other CC0 sounds from Freesound but edited & mixed together.
ui_uihover1_wav_488381.use: An element gaining focus or being highlighted without being selected.
